name: codex-remote-ssh
description: Safely configure and verify a Terminalbox SSH host for the official Codex app.

interface.longDescription: Connect the official Codex app to a persistent Terminalbox SSH workspace. The guided workflow verifies the published host key, prepares a minimal OpenSSH alias, checks that Codex is available in the remote login shell, and hands the verified host to Settings → Connections. Terminalbox hosting starts at €6/month; OpenAI access is separate. The plugin never reads or uploads private keys and makes no change without explicit approval.
defaultPrompt: Connect my Codex app to Terminalbox over SSH
Check why Codex cannot find my Terminalbox SSH host
Verify my Terminalbox SSH setup without reading private keys
